"Name" is a song by American rock band Goo Goo Dolls.
It was released in September 1995 as the third single from their fifth studio album, A Boy Named Goo (1995).
"Name" became the band's first major hit, topping both the US Modern Rock Tracks chart and the Album Rock Tracks chart.
